module: GE extension `core_multiseatPlayerMarkers`: reads and writes the 'multiseatTags' setting that controls the display of player markers (tags) in local multiplayer. Three modes: 'always', 'smart' (default) and 'never'. Old boolean values are converted (true becomes 'smart', false becomes 'never').
notes: getMode rewrites the setting in settings if the stored value was not already normalized (boolean migration).

normalize.desc: Converts a setting value into a valid mode: true becomes 'smart', false becomes 'never', 'always'/'smart'/'never' stay, any other value becomes 'smart'.

getMode.desc: Returns the current mode of the multiseatTags setting (default 'smart'), normalizing it and fixing the setting if needed.

setMode.desc: Normalizes then saves the mode in the multiseatTags setting.

isEnabled.desc: Indicates whether markers are active, i.e. whether the normalized mode is not 'never'.
